entities.summary: Michael May is a former racing driver and engineer from Switzerland. He participated in three Formula One World Championship Grands Prix, debuting on 14 May 1961. He scored no championship points. Michael May was a architects & engineers from Stuttgart (b. 1934-08-18, Stuttgart). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
